questions.question: The source dates Gödel’s incompleteness theorems to 1930 and gives abbreviated hypotheses for both theorems. Confirm whether this refers to announcement or publication and whether the hypotheses should be qualified; the source wording is retained.

reconciliation.text: Complete English adaptation of the Russian publication derivative, manually compared paragraph by paragraph. Bibliographic facts, figure sequence, dates and literal mathematical expressions retained. Editorial publication approval remains pending.
